summary: File-browser listing endpoint GET /agents/<agent_id>/files/ now rejects page numbers above FILE_BROWSER_MAX_PAGE (default 10,000, overridable in settings) with a 400, preventing oversized values from overflowing the agent's pagination math.

statements.why: Pure input-validation tightening (agents/views.py:1866); endpoint stays behind IsAuthenticated + agent permissions; no new exposure.

statements.text: • The agent files part of your server changed in a way plain can't describe yet. /agents/[agent_id]/files
statements.why: Correct endpoint, but gives no explanation.

statements.text: • The agent also changed api/tacticalrmm/agents/tests/test_file_browser.py and api/tacticalrmm/tacticalrmm/constants.py.

misses.what: Remote file browser now refuses page numbers above 10,000 (configurable FILE_BROWSER_MAX_PAGE) with an error instead of passing them to the agent, closing a way to send overflow values to agents.
